about.title: About this project
about.intro: Thank you for using this app. I created this free project so people can gain key knowledge and use our calculator to get insights and make better decisions when facing the big financial choice of buying a first home.
about.support: Please consider supporting this project. It is funded by donations, and that is the only way to keep it going, open, and free.

donate.title: Thank you
donate.body: Thank you for your donation. Your support helps keep these guides and the calculator available for first-time buyers.

footer.disclaimer: Content is educational and is not financial advice.

legal.notAdviceBody: Information on this site is general and educational. Contact your bank, broker, or independent adviser for decisions about your finances.
legal.privacyBody: We do not collect names, email addresses, or other identifying information. You can read the guides and use the investment planner without creating an account.
legal.privacyFeedback: Likes and optional comments on the calculator are anonymous. They are not linked to a name, account, or any other personal details.
legal.privacyLocal: Numbers you enter in the calculator stay in your browser and are not saved on our servers. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.
legal.privacyDonate: If you choose to donate, PayPal handles that payment on their site under their own privacy policy.
legal.contactMeta: If you have any questions about this website, please contact me through LinkedIn.
legal.contactBody: If you have any questions about this website, please contact me through <linkedin>LinkedIn</linkedin>.
